items.author: Musk
items.text: In A SpaceX-Tesla Merger, Elon Musk May Be The Big Winner. What It May Mean For Other Investors.
items.summary_cn: 市场讨论 SpaceX 与 Tesla 合并可能性，TSLA 为直接点名的上市标的；kcn 通过 SPCX/SPCH 间接持有 SpaceX 敞口，相关性强。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk rips ABC News over fatal NYC Tesla crash report
items.summary_cn: Musk 抨击 ABC News 对纽约 Tesla 致命车祸的报道不实，间接维护 TSLA 品牌形象，但事件本身偏舆情，非直接股价催化。

items.author: Musk
items.text: EXCLUSIVE: UK deepens reliance on Musk's SpaceX, spending nearly $40 million on satellite services
items.summary_cn: 英国加深对 SpaceX 卫星服务依赖，签下近 4000 万美元合同，强化 SpaceX 政府/国防订单趋势，间接利好 kcn 的 SPCX/SPCH 持仓。

items.author: Trump
items.text: “Words of Wisdom” from Phil Flynn, one of the World’s Great Oil and Energy Analysts — A MUST SEE! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump转发力挺能源/油价分析师Phil Flynn，间接利好能源板块，与kcn持有的金风科技(02208)板块相关。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Wow! The Populist Party in Germany just had a really big night. They finally got tired of the absolutely horrible Immigration rules and regulations which have hurt Germany so badly. THEY ARE ON THE RISE, and not going to take it anymore! MGGA!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump评论德国选择党崛起、民粹回潮，对欧洲资产/全球风险偏好有间接影响，与kcn恒生科技ETF相关（情绪传导）。

items.author: Musk
items.text: The Boring Company Raises $3 Billion As Demand for Musk Inc Booms
items.summary_cn: The Boring Company 融资 30 亿美元，反映 Musk 系生态需求旺盛；公司未上市，但体现 Musk 帝国整体估值上行趋势。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Katie Miller held large stake in Elon Musk’s xAI as she slammed ChatGPT online
items.summary_cn: 报道 Katie Miller 持有 xAI 大额股份并公开抨击 ChatGPT，间接反映 xAI 估值与 AI 行业竞争格局（xAI 未上市，不计入 tickers）。
